summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026, attaching a press release reaffirming its digital-asset treasury strategy, specifically its continued holding of approximately 195,000 HYPE tokens valued at roughly USD 18.2 million as of that date. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, activist, spin-off, or capital-return transaction is announced. The disclosure is a routine update on corporate treasury holdings and Hyperliquid ecosystem developments, including a manual borrowing feature and U.S. market-structure regulatory attention. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or deal mechanics are stated. No risk-arb angle applies; monitor crypto treasury marks and any future token sales.
